process.title: From casting the brass to the leak test, under one roof

steps.d: Brass alloy with 58–62% copper is cast into the body moulds.
Threads and cartridge seats are machined so the mixer seals without leaks.
Polished in stages until the surface is ready for plating.
Chrome on every model, with gold and matte black coming soon.
The ceramic cartridge, aerator and seals are fitted.
Pressure and leak testing on the line before packing.

about.title: About
about.description: Loaloah Industries is a Saudi mixer manufacturer founded in 2023, with manufacturing experience since 1996. Our vision, mission and values.
about.heading: Loaloah is a Saudi mixer manufacturer
about.lead: We focus on one thing: brass basin and shower mixers, made and tested inside the Kingdom.
story: Loaloah Industries was founded in 2023 to make in the Kingdom what traders and contractors used to import, building on manufacturing experience that goes back to 1996.

Traders today choose between a global brand at a high price, or a cheap import that may come back with scaling and plating complaints. We offer a third option: tested quality, supply from inside the Kingdom, and a price below the global brands.
about.vision: For Loaloah to be the first choice for mixers made in the Kingdom, and to export to neighbouring Arab markets.
about.mission: We make tested, modern brass mixers in the Kingdom at a fair price, and deliver them through traders, plumbers and contractors we serve up close.

values.d: No model ships untested, and no claim is published without a report.

A published guide price that protects the trader's margin.
First reply within one working hour, resolution within one working day.

quality.title: Quality & Certification
quality.description: What we test in Loaloah mixers, what we make them from, and where each certificate stands.
quality.heading: No model ships untested
quality.lead: And no claim is published without a report. This page covers what we test, what we make our mixers from, and what the warranty covers.

tests.d: The ceramic cartridge is tested to 250,000 open-close cycles.
Braided hoses are tested at 60 bar at 23°C, and 30 bar at 90°C.
Each model's flow is measured in an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited lab, and the efficiency label is printed on the box.

materials.d: 58–62% copper. We say “brass alloy”, not “pure copper”, because that is the technically correct description.
Ceramic discs control temperature and flow with a single lever.
For braided hose sleeves and accessories.
Chrome on every model, with gold and matte black coming soon.

warranty: A written warranty on every mixer, with clear terms in the box leaflet.
In-store replacement within a published period.
Original spare parts at every regional distributor.
First reply within one working hour, resolution within one working day.
quality.certsBody: Every certificate is published here when issued. We don't use any body's mark before it is approved.
quality.testsNote: Every mixer also goes through pressure and leak testing on the production line before packing.
